name: layout-topbar
description: The app layout of a site read by scrolling: top bar, the page, footer. Written once as app/layout.receipt.json; every page is drawn in its slot.

knowledge.purpose: The frame every page of a site shares: navigation across the top and the legal line below, written once instead of on each page
antiPatterns: Repeating the navbar or the footer on a page drawn in this layout: the layout already draws them
A second page slot: a layout holds exactly one {"type": "pw:page"}
Setting activeHref on the layout navbar: the engine gives each the current page
knowledge.implementation: The snippet is the layout receipt's one top-level block: {"blocks": [<snippet>]} in app/layout.receipt.json. Each page's top-level blocks replace the bare slot {"type": "pw:page"}, which carries no id and no props. The layout's blocks stay mounted from page to page. The navbar declares activeHref, so the engine fills it with the current page; the navbar sticks through its block style. Needs engine 3.5.

mobileCollapse: The top bar collapses into a drawer; the page and the footer stack.

placeholders.{{FOOTER}}: footer copyright line — PLAIN TEXT, one line. The ONLY place the copyright appears: the `footer` band carries link columns and never a copyright. A rich footer (columns, social) does not go here — place the `footer` pattern as the last band
